# Flux in 60 seconds

::: {.doc-lead}
Flux is a unified workspace for creating scientific and technical materials: figures, papers,
talks, and the reading behind them. It is designed to be a joy to use, and to take the details
that software should handle off your mind.
:::

## Restyle a plot without rerunning it {#restyle-a-plot}

A plot arrives in Flux with its parts still named and its colours still tied to the data.
Select a panel, press **F**, and choose another colormap. The plot, its colour bar and its
ticks change together, straight away, and the analysis never runs again.
